scope: Real detector and answer providers through production Session/TurnDetector/AnswerEngine and localhost websocket; fictional text injected as synthetic STT.
quality_checks: All eight completed primary requests have identical paired model, full-request hash, effective inference-parameter hash and output limit. No pre-end answer events or lifecycle violations. Final emitted answers were spot-checked for consistency with the fictional profile; no blinded semantic quality evaluation.
limitations: Only two pairs per scenario; not production percentiles or a broad quality noninferiority study.
Targeted scenario has a complete punctuated interim 600ms before synthetic speech end; real frequency of this opportunity is not measured.
Provider and detector timing varies. The negative control has one faster and one slower candidate; no consistent ordinary control improvement.
Primary request identity is exact. Dependent detail prompts contain the sampled primary answer and can differ across runs even with identical policy.
No real microphone, Deepgram recognition, remote retrieval, native transport, or WebView paint. Prewarming and follow-user are disabled by the harness.

Main run hit its $1 admission reservation cap: one session was budget-blocked and one was not started. A separate $0.50-capped run completed the missing control pair; failed/not-started outcomes are retained, excluded from paired latency.
Canceled calls retain unresolved cost reservations; known usage is not total billed cost.
